diffs.diff: pin count: part has 10 (+ - IN1 IN2 IN3 IN4 MOTOR-A1 MOTOR-A2 MOTOR-B1 MOTOR-B2), datasheet reading has 6 (+ - IN1 IN2 IN3 IN4)
diffs.evidence: The second reading listed only the control/power header and left out the motor output pads. Components101's MX1508 module pinout table lists: '+ Voltage Input, - Ground, Motor A: Motor A connect pins, Motor B: Motor B connect pins, IN 1..IN 4 Control Signal input' and says 'The motor A and Motor B pins on the motor driver modules can be used to connect the motors'. Each motor needs two terminals (MX1508 chip outputs OUTA1/OUTB1 and OUTA2/OUTB2 per H-bridge), so the red module has 6 pads on the input edge plus 2 MOTOR-A and 2 MOTOR-B pads on the other edge = 10. The model's 6 input-side pins match the second reading exactly; the extra 4 are the real motor output pads.
